name: test_mutable_requirements_block_submit_when_required_owner_data_is_missing
description:
Objective: Mutable requirements block submit when required owner data is missing.
Preconditions: Open Outstanding requirements with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Outstanding requirements.
2. Mutable requirements block submit when required owner data is missing.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The invalid or unauthorized action is rejected and no unintended state change is made.
